name: Starter Valley
description: Career: you start on the old beginner ski hill at the foot of the mountain, with a rusty T-bar and a gravel track. Restore the lift, build your first trails, earn a reputation and buy more land: the Alpine Lift Co. gondola only rents you bike access once you own the land at both its stations.

groups.name: Beginners
groups.values: Feeling safe and a smooth day: easy trails, no scary sections, little waiting, a fair price.

groups.name: Intermediates
groups.values: Flow and fun: well-shaped trails, some variety, a bit of challenge and air, good value for the ticket.

groups.name: Experts
groups.values: Technical difficulty and jump quality: red and black lines with good features.

welcome.title: Welcome to {park}!
paragraphs: The winters down here have run out of snow, so the old beginner ski hill had to close and its T-bar has been rusting ever since. Now the hill is yours: the owners have agreed that you can build whatever you like on it.

Some day you might want to repair the old ski lift and let it pull riders up again (Lifts menu, G). It costs more than you have right now, but the bank has a starter loan for you (Finances menu, M). Until then, riders pedal up the gravel Ski Hill Track.

But first, finish the blue "Easy Peasy" trail. The last owners built three quarters of it, winding down the meadow west of the lift, then stopped halfway down. It isn't connected to the bottom yet, so nobody can ride it:

1. Hire a worker or two in the Crew menu (C). Your crew builds everything you plan.
2. Press T to draw a trail: start on Easy Peasy's loose end, click your way down to the T-bar's valley station next to the parking, then press Enter.
3. Your crew builds the missing stretch. Once it reaches the valley station, Easy Peasy opens and your first guests ride it.
Every trail and feature you build earns XP. New park levels unlock harder features, more land and bigger lifts. Good luck!
